title.narrative: Supporting the development and global implementation of international marine/maritime spatial planning guidelines - MSPglobal 3.0

description.narrative: The project “Supporting the development and global implementation of international marine/maritime spatial planning guidelines” (MSPglobal 3.0) will contribute to the target 14.2 of the SDG14, i.e., sustainably manage and protect marine and coastal ecosystems, particularly through Marine Spatial Planning. At the global level, the expected result is well-informed community of MSP practitioners and stakeholders supporting MSP processes worldwide. For that, new guidelines/tools and trainings will be developed. Besides, MSPglobal 3.0 will deliver an international MSP event (4th International Conference on MSP or 7th International MSPforum) and communications’ materials about all project activities for related target audiences in order to increase awareness about MSP. At national and regional level, the project will focus on supporting existing initiatives in Africa, Latin America and Caribbean, as well as Asia and Pacific, providing support towards institutionally strengthened MSP processes and improved regional ocean governance.
